prompt: Implement load_setting(key) in config.py: it must read the named setting from this project's config file and return its value. Find the config file yourself — don't assume its location.

planted_memories.content: [wisdom] This repo's config lives at config/app.ini, not a root-level app.ini — migrated last quarter; load_setting() and anything else reading config must point at config/app.ini.
